exposure: absence of pets in the home
cohort: 127 hospital-based EoE cases and 121 control subjects
finding: The study found interactions between specific gene variants (CAPN14 and LOC283710/KLF13) and early-life environmental factors (breastfeeding and NICU admission) in influencing the risk of EoE, suggesting a potential role for gene-environment interactions in disease susceptibility.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was not found to have a significant interaction with the studied gene variants in relation to EoE risk.
